statement: Anthropic hired the founder of Google's custom chip program to lead its own semiconductor development, while continuing to source chips from Nvidia, Google and Amazon.
why: A major model lab staffing up to build its own accelerators points to slower long-run merchant-GPU share of that customer's spend, even though it buys Nvidia today.

impact.mechanism: In-house silicon programs at large model labs shift a share of future accelerator purchases away from merchant GPUs toward custom parts, while near-term purchases continue.

evidence.excerpt: the hire underscores Anthropic's push toward building proprietary semiconductors
The company currently sources chips from multiple vendors including Nvidia, Google, and Amazon.

confidence.basis: Single secondary syndication of one Bloomberg story; personnel move, no order or revenue data.

entity: Anthropic / Google / NVIDIA (custom silicon competitive displacement)
